publication_authority: Researcher explicitly requested publication of these 12 microscopy captures in the public Atlas

images.caption: JN1-F32 — spore-print microscopy, original capture 1 of 12. Dispersed, discrete rounded to subrounded objects with refractile peripheral rims; several flattened or asymmetric profiles. No measurement overlays. Spore identity, actual wall thickness, taxon and calibration are not independently confirmed.

JN1-F32 — spore-print microscopy, original capture 2 of 12. Same general field as image 1, with numerous on-image linear annotations. Annotation values are unverified instrument/software readings. Spore identity, actual wall thickness, taxon and calibration are not independently confirmed.

JN1-F32 — spore-print microscopy, original capture 3 of 12. Dense aggregation of round-to-ovoid profiles adjacent to pigmented granular material and threadlike structures; overlapping objects limit boundary assessment. Spore identity, actual wall thickness, taxon and calibration are not independently confirmed.

JN1-F32 — spore-print microscopy, original capture 4 of 12. Relatively dispersed profiles with circular, ovoid and asymmetric outlines; peripheral contrast varies across the field. Spore identity, actual wall thickness, taxon and calibration are not independently confirmed.

JN1-F32 — spore-print microscopy, original capture 5 of 12. Annotated counterpart to image 4 showing individually selected object spans; measurement metadata and calibration are unverified. Spore identity, actual wall thickness, taxon and calibration are not independently confirmed.

JN1-F32 — spore-print microscopy, original capture 6 of 12. Sparser annotated field with dispersed peripheral-rimmed objects; individual spans annotated by the capture software. Spore identity, actual wall thickness, taxon and calibration are not independently confirmed.

JN1-F32 — spore-print microscopy, original capture 7 of 12. Crowded microscopic field with many overlapping spore-like objects adjoining granular/tissue-like aggregates; some outlines obscured. Spore identity, actual wall thickness, taxon and calibration are not independently confirmed.

JN1-F32 — spore-print microscopy, original capture 8 of 12. Annotated counterpart to image 7; scattered selected structures bear on-image micrometer labels, not independently validated. Spore identity, actual wall thickness, taxon and calibration are not independently confirmed.

JN1-F32 — spore-print microscopy, original capture 9 of 12. Dense overlapping bodies near granular material of undetermined origin. A few software length annotations appear near the lower edge; crowding limits interpretation of individual profiles. Spore identity, actual wall thickness, taxon and calibration are not independently confirmed.

JN1-F32 — spore-print microscopy, original capture 10 of 12. Annotated counterpart to image 9; some software measurement marks lie in crowded areas with adjacent or overlapping profiles. Spore identity, actual wall thickness, taxon and calibration are not independently confirmed.

JN1-F32 — spore-print microscopy, original capture 11 of 12. Multiple brownish granular clusters and many rounded to irregular spore-like profiles; source of granular material unconfirmed. Spore identity, actual wall thickness, taxon and calibration are not independently confirmed.

JN1-F32 — spore-print microscopy, original capture 12 of 12. Annotated counterpart to image 11; selected objects have length marks, with calibration status not independently established. Spore identity, actual wall thickness, taxon and calibration are not independently confirmed.
